rounds.text: The business suffers from deteriorating long-term profitability despite any recent short-term optical gains, demonstrated by compounded profit growth plummeting by -9% over 5 years, -33% over 3 years, and -55% over the trailing twelve months [E19, E20, E21]. Return on equity figures further underscore this structural weakness, with the median ROE over 3 years sitting at a low 8% and dropping further to just 4% over the last year [E26, E27], alongside an explicit flag noting a poor ROE of 7.69% over the past 3 years [E60]. Compounding these operational concerns, earnings quality is suspect because recent profits rely partly on Rs. 2.51 Cr of other income [E61], and cash conversion reads a concerning 0.50x where profits sit far ahead of cash, pointing to potential issues with receivables and accruals [E32]. Furthermore, the stock carries severe downside risk for any buyer at current levels, trading 100% of the way up its 52-week range [E5] with an extreme annualized volatility of 71.8% [E50] and a historically punishing peak-to-trough drawdown of -63.0% [E49]. Conceded: [E41].
